artworks.title: Willows of the Mottiaux Islands
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Lawrence Lawver
artworks.description: The image shows a water scene with trees along a strip of land. The horizon is not visible due to the foliage. The artwork includes detailed sketching with fine lines and cross-hatching for textures. It uses a monochrome color palette of black and white. The water reflects the trees and a boat is visible in the distance. The background is filled with dense tree foliage.

artworks.title: Allegory in Honor of the Arrival of Cardinal Franciotti as Bishop of Lucca
artworks.medium: etching with burnished tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with classical figures and cherubs. The artwork features a dense and complex composition with numerous cherubs scattered throughout the scene. At the center, several classical figures are depicted in flowing garments, surrounded by a landscape of large trees and a stone structure. There is a winged creature resembling a griffin, hovering atop a cloud. The scene exudes an ethereal atmosphere, intricate with detailed linework, capturing a sense of movement and drama typical of a baroque style.

artworks.title: The Little Boat, or The Happy Union
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Katherine Shepard Fund and Gifts of Funds from Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a low-angle view of a small boat being rowed across a river. A woman reclines under a canopy, a man rows the boat, and a young boy is also seen rowing. Surrounding the river are dense trees, with a stately house and a person near the entrance visible in the background. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette with finely detailed brushstrokes.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a central figure in a stone structure. The composition captures an intense and dramatic scene, set within a cave-like environment made of stone blocks. The central figure is lying across a stone surface or table and is surrounded by several figures draped in flowing robes, each appearing deeply engaged in the scene's events. The atmosphere is one of reverence and emotion, emphasized by the detailed expressions and gestures of the surrounding figures. Light enters the scene through a small, square opening in the stone structure. A large urn is positioned on the ground to the right side of the composition. The detailed rendering of textures, from the stone walls to the folds of fabric, enhances the dramatic and historical tone of the composition.

artworks.title: The Grill of the Tomb of Piero and Giovanni de' Medici
artworks.artist: Cornelis Cort, after Andrea del Verrocchio
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural panel. The image depicts an intricately designed architectural feature characterized by a lattice pattern with floral embellishments. The border is adorned with detailed floral and leaf motifs, and beneath the lattice is a richly decorated cartouche with inscriptions, surrounded by acanthus leaves and decorative elements. The drawing presents a high level of detail and precision.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving with multiple figures in a detailed scene. All figures are depicted in seated or kneeling positions, focusing on a central scene involving a baby. On the left, two angelic figures are shown with wings, appearing reverent or prayerful. In the center, there is an elderly woman holding the child, with another woman beside her. A younger woman is kneeling in front with her hands in a prayer position. On the right, a bearded man leans on a staff, observing the scene. The background includes draped fabric and architectural elements. An ornate basket filled with fruit is in the lower right corner. The overall tone is one of devotion and attentiveness towards the child.

artworks.title: On the Banks of the Loing: The Cart
artworks.medium: etching with bitten tone and burnishing on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with an elevated point of view overlooking land and water. The horizon is high in the frame, with hills in the distance. On the left, there is a cart next to a road lined with trees and a fence leading to a small house. The road continues, flanked by trees, leading to a riverbank with two figures nearby. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, resembling etching. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia brown tones against a light beige background.

artworks.title: On the Banks of the Loing: Six Boats at their Moorings
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with buildings along the left shoreline. There are small boats with figures rowing in the water, one towards the right side. The etching has thin lines outlining buildings, trees, and boats, creating a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic with a sepia tone. The background extends into the distance on the right side.

artworks.title: On the Banks of the Loing: Houses by the Water
artworks.medium: etching with burnishing on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a shoreline with a body of water, buildings, and trees in the distance. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition. A few trees and buildings are visible on the horizon. The technique uses light etching lines to create a sketch-like quality. The color palette is various shades of brown and beige. The water reflects the buildings and trees, with subtle ripples indicated by fine lines.

artworks.title: On the Banks of the Loing: The Canal Bank
artworks.medium: etching with burnishing on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside or coastal scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is placed around the upper third of the image, where the water meets the distant land. In the distance, there are trees and buildings along the shoreline. Some structures are visible reaching upwards. The image uses delicate brushwork or etching to create soft details. The color palette is monochromatic, predominantly beige and sepia. Close to the viewer, there are fence-like structures and trees along a path, with a small boat on the water's edge. Figures and structures in the distance blend seamlessly with the environment.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques de Boissieu, after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: etching on light blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the shoulders up. He is positioned facing slightly to the viewer's right, with his gaze directed forward. His facial features include a prominent brow, a mature and somewhat rounded face, deep-set eyes, and a beard that covers his chin and runs along his jawline. The man's hair is short, dark, and styled backward. He is dressed in a dark garment with a wide, elaborate white collar. The background appears as a textured, sketchy expanse, with a focus on the contrast between the etched lines and the lighter areas. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects being held by the man.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques de Boissieu, after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The person has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a bushy, well-groomed beard and mustache. The hair is short and neatly combed, receding slightly at the temple. The individual is wearing a dark garment with a white, pleated collar. The background is plain with no additional objects visible.

artworks.title: Saint Charles Borromeo Distributing Communion to the Victims of the Plague of 1576 in Milan
artworks.medium: etching touched with black ink on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The drawing depicts a group of figures gathered closely together. One central figure is wearing ornate vestments and holding an object, possibly a bowl. Another figure behind holds a staff topped with a crucifix. The surrounding architecture and attire suggest a historical or biblical setting, with buildings featuring arches and columns. The scene conveys interaction and focus among the figures, as they appear engaged in an important moment. The use of line work is detailed, providing depth and texture to the characters and setting, with cross-hatching used for shadows and highlights.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist in the River Jordan
artworks.artist: Benoît Audran I, after Nicolas Poussin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts several people in various positions at the edge of a body of water, likely a river. Many individuals are shown standing, sitting, or kneeling. On the left, a man is sitting on a horse with his arm resting on its head. Nearby, two men are standing and conversing, and another man is shirtless with a cloth around his waist. In the center foreground, a shirtless man is standing beside another man who is half-kneeling. To the right, a seated woman tends to a child, while another woman stands holding a baby. The group exhibits varying hairstyles and is dressed in long robes or loose fabrics. Some figures are kneeling near the water, and others are crossing the river in a boat in the background under a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Amphion and Zethus Tying Dirce to a Wild Bull
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 40.01 × 27.62 cm (15 3/4 × 10 7/8 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a bull and multiple human figures. The artwork depicts several figures engaged in various activities around a bull. The central figure is grasping the bull's head, while another is pulling on a rope wrapped around the bull's neck. A small dog stands on its hind legs, interacting with one of the figures, while an additional figure is seated to the side. Various elements around the figures suggest a classical theme, reinforced by draped garments and the bull itself. The detailed line work and shading bring a sense of depth and dimension to the figures and animals, contributing to the intense and active composition.

artworks.title: Mount Serbal, from the Wádee Feyrán, Egypt
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gary B. Sokol
artworks.description: The image depicts a rocky terrain with a mountain range in the distance. A tree with sprawling branches is in the foreground, surrounded by stony ground, small bushes, and rock formations leading towards the mountains. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of sepia and earthy browns. The play of light and shadow highlights the textural qualities of the elements.

artworks.title: West Point, New York, from Garrison’s
artworks.medium: stereoscopic glass transparency
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Denise Bethel in honor of Benjamin Carter Bethel
artworks.description: The image shows a stereograph featuring two near-identical photographs side by side of a tranquil water scene. The point of view is from a slight height, overlooking a calm body of water with a rocky shoreline and a small dock. In the distance, a shoreline meets the water, with rolling hills and faint buildings visible. Close by, a wooden dock extends into the water and a small boathouse is near the shore. The color palette is muted sepia tones, creating a nostalgic and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Denise Bethel in honor of Benjamin Carter Bethel
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated facing forward with her right elbow resting on a surface and her index finger touching her cheek. She has large eyes, a straight nose, slightly parted lips, and neatly styled brown hair. She is dressed in a striped gray garment with colorful floral trimming, a lace collar and cuffs. She holds a white lace or fabric in her left hand. She wears small earrings and a brooch with a rose design. The background has a dark green wall and rich red drapes. There is a dark-clothed table with a vanity mirror behind her to the left.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Denise Bethel in honor of Etta Henley Bethel
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the hips up. Her body faces slightly to the right while her head is turned towards the camera. She has shoulder-length dark hair styled smoothly and parted in the center. The woman's expression is neutral. She is wearing a detailed patterned dress with delicate lace and intricate embroidery, including small red details. A lace shawl or overlay is draped over her shoulders. Her left hand holds a part of the fabric, while her right hand rests on the top of a dark wooden chair with a cushioned seat. The woman wears a bracelet on her left wrist. The background is a simple muted gradient.

artworks.title: The Creation of the Animals
artworks.medium: woodcut from four blocks on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a natural setting with various animals and celestial elements. There is a central figure with a halo-like aura, standing among animals such as lions, elephants, birds, and snakes. The scene includes abundant foliage, a tall palm tree to the left, and a grand old tree to the right. Above, the sky shows celestial bodies including a sun and moon surrounded by stars. The ground features creatures like a snail, frog, and rooster. The overall composition suggests a vision of wildlife and nature, possibly depicting a creation or beginnings theme. The style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer, known for intricate woodcuts and detailed compositions.

artworks.title: Portrait of Pope Innocent IX
artworks.medium: engraving and etching
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a man from the waist up, facing the viewer. He has a long beard, is wearing a cap, robe, and is holding fabric across his chest. The background includes a coat of arms and decorative elements. Text above the figure reads "ABUNDANTIA." The border identifies the figure as "INNOCENTIVS IX PAPA BONONIENSIS SEDIT MENSIS II."

artworks.title: Johannes Brahms, Leipzig
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated in a chair with a high backrest. Their right elbow is on a table with a patterned cloth, supporting their head. The person has medium-length light-colored hair, wearing a dark suit with a collared shirt and tie. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: A Cliff Overhung with Trees
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the forest floor looking up towards a rocky outcropping with tall trees. The horizon is not visible, as the scene is dominated by the vertical rise of the cliff and the tree canopy overhead. The brushwork in the painting includes detailed and loose, flowing brushstrokes capturing the textures of leaves and rocks. The sky and background are left somewhat undefined. The color palette features earthy tones with greens, browns, sandy yellows, and muted blues. The ground is covered with rocks and vegetation, leading to a cliff face adorned with climbing foliage. In the background, tree tops meet a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray wash and white gouache over traces of black chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered in a landscape scene by a river or body of water. The composition features an arrangement of figures in flowing garments, surrounded by trees and bushes, with a view of architectural structures and vegetation in the background. The drawing is detailed, with expressive lines and a subtle use of shading to imply depth and movement among the figures. The overall style and line work indicate it could be in the manner of a classical or renaissance-inspired artist.
